nom: medicube Red Succinic Acid Peeling Pad

segments.combination: Two reviewers with combination skin report clearer skin, fewer blackouts, and reduced pore size, though one needed a thicker moisturizer after experiencing severe dryness and stiffness from overuse.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer who broke out badly speculated her skin may be too sensitive for this product.
segments.mature: One reviewer describes herself as middle-aged with acne-prone skin and reports a big improvement in clarity after a few weeks.

concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report dryness or a dull, stiff, tight feeling, with one describing her face as dry and dull and another needing a thicker moisturizer to counteract stiffness after using it twice in one day.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports her face became completely stiff and dry after using the product both morning and night, resolved by moisturizing and reducing frequency.
concerns.spots: Reviewers with acne-prone or combination skin report clearer skin, fewer blackheads, and reduced breakouts on the forehead and face sides after two weeks; however, four other reviewers report the product broke them out significantly, in one case worse than ever before.
concerns.blemishes: Some acne-prone reviewers describe clear improvement and no new hormonal breakouts; others describe severe new breakouts, with one suspecting purging rather than true improvement.

aspects.libelle: Requires reduced frequency and heavier moisturizer
